caption: The drawing depicts a single object positioned centrally on the paper, consisting of a tall, symmetrical vase or urn-like form. The vessel features a narrow neck with a small lip, widening smoothly into a rounded shoulder and tapering down into a long, conical body. This conical body sits atop a decorative base, which includes a rounded, ribbed element that flares outward into a series of vertical, petal-like structures. The entire structure rests upon a simple, square pedestal. The drawing is rendered in shades of gray, giving the object a monochromatic appearance, and is set against a plain, light beige background. The surface detailing, shading, and highlights give the object a three-dimensional and metallic or stone-like appearance. There is a small, handwritten inscription in the lower left corner.
title: Lamp
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
